title: Jail Capacity and Incarceration Alternatives
question_text: How should government respond to jail overcrowding and criminal justice demand?

stances.text: Redirecting incarceration funding into community-based mental health, addiction, housing, and restorative justice programs to shrink the jail system
Reducing the incarcerated population through alternatives to incarceration rather than building new capacity
Upgrading jail facilities only as needed to meet constitutional standards, without expanding overall capacity
Building additional jail capacity to address overcrowding and facility deficiencies
Expanding jail capacity as the primary response to crime, prioritizing detention over alternatives
